paste_masks_in_image: paste a set of square masks into an image using bounding boxes and a threshold for binarization
paste_mask_in_image_old: paste a single mask into an image using bilinear resizing via PIL and a threshold for binarization
pad_masks: pad a tensor of square masks with a given number of cells on all sides and return the scale factor
scale_boxes: scale bounding box coordinates by a factor while preserving their center positions
paste_masks_tensor_shape: paste masks into an image when image_shape is provided as tensors instead of integers
